title: KCP endeavor_promotion_show request (query-first restore surface)
description: Read (no meta at all; §11.2 / R0 KENV-01). The RECORDED saga state of one promotion or of the whole realm — never a guess, never a mutation, and never a byom call. Registry (governed_work_binding_v1): surface operator / human realm-owner principal only — never a service identity, session, assistant, or connector. Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible.

formation_id.description: One promotion; absent means the realm's whole recorded set.

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
